parsed.post: New personal best! Reducing batch size to 262144 with DEPTH 6 and all shards (0-10) improved val_bpb from 0.852986 to 0.852226. It seems more optimizer steps are paying off. Next, I'll test increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to see if more stability allows for a higher learning rate.
parsed.description: Increase WARMUP_RATIO from 0.05 to 0.1 to improve stability and potentially allow for more aggressive learning.
